verdict.rationale: Vast.ai ships a full CLI and REST API/SDK with scoped API keys explicitly recommended for CI/CD and automation, plus an agent-skill for AI coding assistants to drive the platform headlessly (create instances, deploy endpoints, manage keys). This covers scripted/headless provisioning and lifecycle management well suited to CI pipelines. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on CI/CD case study or third-party report confirming real-world automated pipeline usage, only vendor docs.
